name: VIP
displayDescription:
Choose your own effects color!
Customize your Awakening outfit!
Unlock emotes with just 35 kills!
Customize your killstreak color!
Get a special announcement when you join!
Customize your own VIP Cape with a Custom Color and Image!
Display a cool VIP title and icon!
Customize everything in settings!

name: Private Server Commands
displayDescription:
YOU MUST OWN A PRIVATE SERVER FOR THIS TO WORK!
Enable this exclusive game pass through the settings icon (top-left).

Purchase allows access to tons of fun commands, and lots of server customization settings!

btw you can type kick (playername or playerid) to kick them from your private server

name: Early Access
displayDescription:
Get the ability to play unreleased characters, even if their moveset is not complete.
Keep in mind once these characters are finished they will be released for free.

Change characters in the top left!

name: Custom Move Text
displayDescription: Allows you to display a custom text message above your head whenever you use any move. Customize in the top left settings!

name: Custom Kill Sound
displayDescription: Allows you to play an audio whenever you get a kill!

name: Emote Pages
displayDescription:
Gives you FOUR extra rows of emotes, allowing you to easily pick between 20 emote slots and 40 if you have VIP!
Unlocks 3 emotes on purchase (if you already have max emotes, lets you redeem 3 free emotes next time we add emotes)

name: Cosmetics
displayDescription:
Instantly unlock all total kill reward cosmetics in game!
Includes several cool capes, masks, and gauntlets!

(DOES NOT INCLUDE EVENT COSMETICS)
